errors.evidence: Thought: I will now document my reasoning. There are two different sources of data for the chinstrap penguin global population. One is a Wikipedia page that, as of the end of 2018, lists the population of chinstrap penguins as approximately 8,000,000 individual birds. The other source is a 2020 Nature.com article (“global population assessment of the Chinstrap penguin”) which reported the population in terms of breeding pairs. In that article the estimate was about 1,300,000 breeding pairs; assuming two birds per pair gives 2,600,000 individuals.
